Specification:
Two-phase snapshot. Async active-low rst_n clears sampled, visible and published. Only FALLING clk edges update sampled: clear_sample has priority and sets sampled=0; else capture=1 samples unsigned 2-bit data; else hold. Only RISING clk edges update visible and published: published=publish, and publish=1 copies the previously captured sampled into visible; publish=0 holds visible. capture/clear_sample/data have no effect on a rising edge and publish has no effect on a falling edge. sampled is exposed directly; all three outputs hold while clk remains at either level, independent of input changes. Reset assertion and release at stable high or low are defined: assertion clears immediately, release alone must not update anything. All binary inputs defined.
